title.narrative: Eletric buses & industry transformation in Brazil: accelerating just and green transition

description.narrative: The project leads Brazil's e-mobility initiative, concentrating on electric buses and infrastructure. It aims to mitigate climate change through regulation, financing, pilots, and industry collaboration. The goal is to replace 1,739 conventional buses with electric ones, reducing 394,385 tons of CO2. By project's end, local governments will be empowered to implement e-mobility projects in three cities, prioritizing equity and inclusion. A first-loss guarantee scheme covers initial losses, thereby reducing the risk for private investors. A stable market for e-buses and investment security will be created by securing long-term contracts and government commitments. Cross-ministerial coordination will drive sectoral action plans, aligning with Brazil's climate targets. The domestic e-bus industry will boost technological capacity, and the workforce will be diversified, with enhanced roles for women and marginalized individuals, fostering leadership in the industry and transport sector.
